Title: Say
Description: A spoken line. Consecutive lines get a Continue button; the last line before options is shown with them.

Inputs.Description: Connect to the Body pin of a Passage, Option, Branch or Alternative. Statements run in the order of their links.

Options.Label: Speaker (optional)
Options.Description: Who says it. Leave empty for the dialogue's speaker, normally the NPC's name.

Options.Label: Text
Options.Description: What is said. Text may use {player}, {npc}, {$var}, {expr ? a : b} and [one|of|these].

Options.Label: Continue button
Options.Description: Label of the button after this line, e.g. Go on. Leave empty for Continue.
